mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the negative economic signal.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic output and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals a supportive monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors benefit from low discount rates and stable inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
